Binance says thinly traded tokens are delaying full replacement of stolen assets

Binance attributes its last reported 5% replenishment gap to less-liquid assets, while its November 3 withdrawal plan reopens routes progressively.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 Binance's November 3 plan calls for withdrawals to reopen progressively as each asset-network pair clears security checks. 02 The 95% replenishment figure was reported November 1 and repeated November 2; remaining tokens are harder to source. 03 Binance says its completed reserve proof covers ten tokens at an Oct. 31 snapshot; a broader snapshot is planned for Nov. 4. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Binance said in its Nov. 2 recovery update that less-liquid tokens were slowing the replacement of stolen assets. It put the outstanding replenishment at approximately 5% of the impacted amount, while a separate withdrawal phase was scheduled for Nov. 3.

The new phase was scheduled to begin at 04:00 UTC. In Binance's Nov. 3 update , the exchange said availability would expand progressively as security and readiness checks were completed for individual assets and networks.

Together, the disclosures explain why a commitment to cover stolen funds can coexist with unfinished recovery. Funding the purchases, obtaining the specific tokens and restoring the routes through which customers withdraw them are separate tasks.

Binance recovery has separate checkpoints

The replenishment percentage, dated reserve proof and asset-network reopening answer different questions.

REPLENISHMENT · LAST REPORTED NOV. 2 ~95% of the impacted amount ~5% outstanding Less-liquid tokens outside the named ten Market / OTC purchases + industry partners Nov. 1 figure repeated Nov. 2. This is a replenishment measure. REPLENISHMENT Nov. 1 figure · repeated Nov. 2 ~95% of the impacted amount ~5% outstanding Less-liquid tokens outside the named ten Market / OTC + industry partners

Compare the other recovery milestones Dated reserve proof Withdrawal routes Binance said proof for ten tokens at the October 31 snapshot was complete on November 2. This concerns backing at that snapshot.

SNAPSHOT · OCT. 31, 00:00 UTC BTC ETH USDT BNB SOL USDC XRP USD1 RLUSD ZEC Proof complete Nov. 2 Ten named tokens Binance says users can verify minimum 1:1 backing at that snapshot. SNAPSHOT · OCT. 31 00:00 UTC · ten named tokens BTC ETH USDT BNB SOL USDC XRP USD1 RLUSD ZEC Proof complete Nov. 2 Binance says minimum 1:1 backing at the dated snapshot.

The November 3 plan reopens asset-network pairs progressively after security checks. These examples do not establish current availability.

NOV. 3 PLAN · PROGRESSIVE REOPENING FROM 04:00 UTC TOKEN CHECK EACH PAIR NETWORK RLUSD USDC ? Ethereum ? XRP ? Sui ? = live status not established here. Check each planned pair after security checks. NOV. 3 · PROGRESSIVE ROLLOUT Planned from 04:00 UTC TOKEN CHECK NETWORK RLUSD ? Ethereum RLUSD ? XRP USDC ? Sui ? = live status not established here. Security checks apply to each pair.

A replenishment percentage does not establish that a particular withdrawal route is available.

Binance's statements are attributed reporting. The denominator's valuation basis is unspecified. No live route status or unreplenished token identity is established; the October 31 proof concerns ten named tokens.

Binance Recovery Update #6, Nov. 3 Binance Recovery Update #4, Nov. 1 Binance Recovery Update #5, Nov. 2 Supporting facts

Binance announced a further progressive withdrawal rollout beginning at 04:00 UTC on November 3, with listed assets becoming available as security and readiness checks are completed rather than all at once. [1] Binance's November 3 update says it is restoring each network-asset pair after security checks, prioritizing tokens using demand over the past week, and adding more assets as they become ready. [1] Binance reported on November 1 that it had covered approximately 95% of the impacted amount and repeated that figure on November 2. [2] [3] Binance said the outstanding approximately 5% of the impacted amount comprised tokens outside BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC, and that these less-liquid assets take longer to source at the required scale. [3] Binance said it was continuing to acquire the remaining affected assets through market and over-the-counter channels and working with industry partners on the acquisitions. [2] [3] Binance said on November 2 that the zero-knowledge proof for its October 31, 00:00 UTC reserve snapshot was complete and users holding the ten named tokens could verify at least one-for-one backing. [3] Binance's ten-token snapshot and associated proof concern a specified asset set at October 31, 00:00 UTC; the withdrawal rollout separately concerns asset-network pairs and security readiness. [3] [1] Binance's November 3 planned-withdrawal table includes RLUSD on the Ethereum and XRP networks and USDC on Sui, but the announcement does not establish that all those routes are currently available. [1] Binance advised users to check the withdrawal page for their chosen asset and network or its network-status page, and warned that rollout traffic could cause delays or longer processing times. [1] Method

Source-bound comparison of Binance's disclosures. The approximate 95/5 bar represents the stated shares of the impacted amount, not token counts, dollars or withdrawal routes. Named pairs are examples from the planned November 3 table.

Binance's statements are attributed reporting. The denominator's valuation basis is unspecified. No live route status or unreplenished token identity is established; the October 31 proof concerns ten named tokens.

Binance reported approximately 95% replenishment of the impacted amount in its Nov. 1 recovery update . It repeated that figure on Nov. 2, attributing the outstanding portion to tokens outside the ten assets it said were fully backed: BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC.

The exchange said the remaining assets were less liquid and took longer to source in the required quantities. It described continued purchases through market and over-the-counter channels, alongside work with industry partners to finish the acquisitions.

In its Oct. 31 update , Binance identified corporate treasury, a planned partial deployment of its Secure Asset Fund for Users and a portion of its futures insurance resources as recovery funding sources.

The percentage also has a narrower meaning than a general recovery score. Binance describes the denominator as the impacted amount. It does not specify the valuation basis in those disclosures, so the remaining 5% cannot safely be converted into a dollar shortfall. Nor does 95% describe the proportion of tokens or withdrawal routes restored.

Binance's Nov. 2 update said the zero-knowledge proof for its Oct. 31, 00:00 UTC reserve snapshot was complete. It said holders of the ten named tokens could independently verify that their balances were backed at least one-for-one.

posts.content:
Crypto spent $55 million defending a senator who already backed CLARITY

One of crypto's most expensive election bets is playing out in Ohio, where winning could leave the industry's biggest problem in Washington untouched.

By Andjela Radmilac Senior Analyst • CryptoSlate

01 Crypto-backed Defend American Jobs spent more than $55 million supporting Husted and opposing Brown in Ohio. 02 Husted already voted to advance the CLARITY Act, which failed to reach the Senate's 60-vote threshold. 03 Tuesday's election could change Senate control without resolving the bill's disagreements. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Defend American Jobs, a crypto-backed political group, spent more than $55 million supporting Republican Jon Husted and opposing Sherrod Brown in Ohio between Sept. 21 and Oct. 26, according to Americans for Financial Reform. Husted had already voted to advance the CLARITY Act.

Americans vote today, Nov. 3, in midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the next two years. Republicans currently control both chambers.

Congress has to agree on crypto legislation, which means winning over enough lawmakers in both parties to get it passed.

The midterms will shape committee leadership, hearings and the path to a vote. Presidents appoint regulators and set enforcement priorities, but a later administration can change those policies.

Crypto-backed groups have poured money into congressional races , often backing candidates based on their crypto positions rather than their party.

Fairshake and its affiliated groups have become some of the biggest spenders in American politics, with a Reuters analysis estimating that crypto groups had spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 races by late October.

Ohio has become a major focus of that strategy.

Husted already voted in September to advance the CLARITY Act, a major proposal intended to establish clearer federal rules for crypto. The bill failed to clear a 60-vote Senate hurdle , leaving its supporters short of the backing needed to move forward. Brown, meanwhile, wasn't even in the Senate when that happened, having lost his previous seat in 2024 before launching a comeback campaign against Husted for Ohio's other Senate seat.

Keeping Husted in Washington would protect a vote the industry already has, while defeating Brown would prevent a prominent crypto critic from returning to Congress. Both outcomes would be politically valuable, especially with Senate control potentially at stake, but neither will resolve the disagreements that stopped the legislation in September.

That's because lawmakers are still fighting over stablecoin rewards, banking risks and the protections customers should receive when crypto companies handle their money, and the industry's expensive election campaign can't settle those disputes on its own.

Republicans currently hold 53 seats , so even a united Republican caucus would need support from outside the party to reach the 60-vote threshold used in September.

Susan Collins, Josh Hawley, and Jerry Moran all voted against moving ahead . Thom Tillis recorded a no as well, but did so to preserve the option of asking the Senate to reconsider , a procedural step that would allow another attempt rather than an expression of opposition to the bill itself.

Collins wanted further study of whether community banks and credit unions could lose deposits used to support “loans for mortgages, small businesses, and other family needs.” The dispute centers partly on stablecoin rewards. Crypto platforms offer rewards to customers who keep stablecoins in an account, giving those customers another reason to leave their money there, so banks see those offers as competition for money that might otherwise sit in a deposit account. Banking groups argue that losing those deposits could make it harder to fund lending , and they have pushed lawmakers to restrict rewards that work like interest.

Thanks for signing up to The Catalyst. Look out for your first daily email. If you already receive it, you’re all set.

The September proposal would restrict payments by third parties, such as exchanges , when those payments function like interest on bank deposits. It would still allow rewards tied to transactions or activity, which draws a distinction between paying someone to leave a balance untouched and rewarding them for actually using it.

Banking associations argue that the proposed distinction leaves ways to keep paying what is effectively interest , even when the payment is described or structured differently.

Under the September draft, Treasury could impose further restrictions if stablecoin yield caused substantial harm to community-bank deposits within 18 months of enactment. The sponsors presented that provision as protection for smaller banks and the businesses that rely on them.

Banking groups objected that waiting until significant damage had occurred would make the protection come too late. Their response called for tighter restrictions in the legislation itself , rather than relying on regulators to act after deposits had already moved.

Nevada Democrat Catherine Cortez Masto raised a different set of objections, saying the September version left unresolved problems involving illicit finance, prediction markets, and ethics . She supported the separate GENIUS stablecoin legislation, but said this proposal didn't do enough to help law enforcement address crypto crime or resolve concerns about political conflicts.

The sponsors said they incorporated 126 substantive changes requested by Democrats and revised the restrictions governing public officials’ crypto interests. Cortez Masto’s response was that important problems remained and that Republican Senate leaders had ended negotiations before they were resolved.

Those objections would still need answers after a Husted victory, unless the sponsors could find enough support elsewhere.

Even after an agreement in the Senate, the House would have to approve the same legislative text before it could go to the president. Democrats could ask for different terms from those accepted by the current chamber if they won a House majority, including in a scenario where Republicans held the Senate.

Congress can also act after the election and before its current term ends on Jan. 3, 2027 . That period gives lawmakers another opportunity to negotiate.

Bills that have not become law by the end of a Congress don't carry over automatically . The legislation would need to be introduced again and work through the process, leaving the newly elected House and Senate to decide which parts of the September proposal they were willing to keep.

posts.titleVi: 7,934 New XRP Wallets in One Day: Network Activity Defies Sunday Slowdown
posts.summary: XRP network growth appears to have picked up pace even as its price hovers near $1.25. Santiment found that 7,934 new wallets were created on November 1st, which happens to be the sixth-highest daily total of 2026.
posts.summaryVi: XRP network growth appears to have picked up pace even as its price hovers near $1.25. Santiment found that 7,934 new wallets were created on November 1st, which happens to be the sixth-highest daily total of 2026.
posts.content:
XRP network growth appears to have picked up pace even as its price hovers near $1.25. Santiment found that 7,934 new wallets were created on November 1st, which happens to be the sixth-highest daily total of 2026.

That’s notable, especially since Sundays are usually quieter for crypto network activity.

The surge follows a busy week for XRP and came just after the Binance hack, which may have pushed more users toward self-custody and fresh wallets. Santiment said that strong network growth suggests usage is improving while price remains under pressure. The immediate pivot is $1.25, and $1.30 is the first level that would confirm stronger momentum.

If daily new-wallet growth stays above roughly 4,000 and XRP reclaims $1.30, the setup looks more constructive. On the other hand, a drop below $1.20 and growth under 3,000 would weaken that signal.

CryptoPotato recently reported that XRP whale outflows on Binance also surged nearly three times the September 2022 reading. These outflows could ease near-term selling pressure.

XRP and other top caps such as Bitcoin and Ethereum have already been witnessing weakening sentiment for nearly two months. The Binance hack further accelerated the downfall. As prices have fallen and fear has spread across the market, bullish commentary has collapsed. XRP now has just 0.61 bullish comments for every bearish one, while Bitcoin stands at around 0.69.

Ethereum is holding up better at around 1.14, but enthusiasm has still fallen sharply from September. These ratios give a clearer picture of when retail traders become unusually confident or fearful, and right now, fear has clearly swept over the crypto community.

Santiment revealed that the darkest sentiment periods have often created the strongest contrarian opportunities once panic has had time to settle. The community is still reeling from crypto’s largest-ever hack, which makes the current situation particularly difficult. Despite this, if BTC and XRP sentiment stays below 1.0 while prices stop making new lows, a mid-term relief rally could eventually take shape.

“Extreme fear alone does not mark the exact bottom, but fear plus price stabilization has often been a much stronger signal.”

Chayanika has been working as a financial journalist for seven years. A graduate in Political Science and Journalism, her interest lies in regulatory implications with a focus on technological evolution in the crypto realm.

The immediate pivot is $1.25, and $1.30 is the first level that would confirm stronger momentum.

If daily new-wallet growth stays above roughly 4,000 and XRP reclaims $1.30, the setup looks more constructive. On the other hand, a drop below $1.20 and growth under 3,000 would weaken that signal.

CryptoPotato recently reported that XRP whale outflows on Binance also surged nearly three times the September 2022 reading. These outflows could ease near-term selling pressure.

XRP and other top caps such as Bitcoin and Ethereum have already been witnessing weakening sentiment for nearly two months. The Binance hack further accelerated the downfall. As prices have fallen and fear has spread across the market, bullish commentary has collapsed. XRP now has just 0.61 bullish comments for every bearish one, while Bitcoin stands at around 0.69.

Ethereum is holding up better at around 1.14, but enthusiasm has still fallen sharply from September. These ratios give a clearer picture of when retail traders become unusually confident or fearful, and right now, fear has clearly swept over the crypto community.

Santiment revealed that the darkest sentiment periods have often created the strongest contrarian opportunities once panic has had time to settle. The community is still reeling from crypto’s largest-ever hack, which makes the current situation particularly difficult. Despite this, if BTC and XRP sentiment stays below 1.0 while prices stop making new lows, a mid-term relief rally could eventually take shape.

“Extreme fear alone does not mark the exact bottom, but fear plus price stabilization has often been a much stronger signal.”

North Korea denies role in $6 billion Binance hack after FBI accusation

Reuters, citing KCNA, reported the denial after the FBI blamed TraderTraitor for stealing more than $6 billion from Binance.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 Kim Yo Jong dismissed US claims linking North Korea to the Binance hack as “absurd rhetoric,” Reuters reported on November 2, citing KCNA. 02 The FBI attributed the theft to TraderTraitor and urged crypto services to block transactions involving listed wallets and derived funds. 03 Investigators observed conversion primarily into ether, while further laundering through DeFi and instant-swap services remained an FBI expectation. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Kim Yo Jong, sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, dismissed US claims linking the country to the Binance hack as “absurd rhetoric,” Reuters reported on Nov. 2, citing the Korean Central News Agency, or KCNA. The denial disputes the US government's attribution of the theft of more than $6 billion from the cryptocurrency exchange.

The FBI had blamed North Korea's TraderTraitor operation in an Oct. 31 alert, placing the theft on or about Oct. 29. TraderTraitor is the bureau's name for the specific North Korean cyber activity it identified in the attack.

Related Reading FBI blames North Korea for $6 billion Binance hack, urges THORChain to block stolen funds

Blockchain intelligence firm TRM Labs estimated that approximately $6 billion left Binance wallets across ten blockchains, with most of the funds moving in about 20 minutes beginning at 20:05 UTC on Oct. 29. The firm's initial figures reflected observations through 00:30 UTC on Oct. 30.

TRM attributed the Binance hack to TraderTraitor with high confidence, citing on-chain and off-chain intelligence.

The firm also assessed that valid signed transfers across different blockchains pointed to a compromise of Binance's hot-wallet signing infrastructure. That would place the breach in the systems used to authorize outgoing wallet transactions. The explanation remains TRM's assessment of how the transfers were enabled. Its conclusion connects the ability to produce valid transfers on different networks with a potential weakness in the infrastructure used to sign those transactions.

FBI seeks to block transactions linked to the Binance hack

The FBI said investigators working with the US Secret Service and IRS Criminal Investigation had observed the actors converting stolen assets primarily into ether. The bureau expected further laundering through decentralized finance, or DeFi, and instant-swap services.

Related Reading Binance hackers deploy never-seen-before laundering tactics to conceal $6.3 billion theft

The alert urged cryptocurrency service providers to block transactions involving the listed theft-linked addresses. It described those wallets as operated by, or closely connected to, TraderTraitor actors. CryptoSlate reported the FBI attribution and blocking appeal on Nov. 1, before the North Korean denial.

The request extends beyond exchanges to blockchain infrastructure operators, DeFi services and analytics firms. The FBI specifically named THORNode operators, RPC node operators and instant exchanges, alongside decentralized services and other businesses that handle virtual assets. It covers transactions involving both the identified addresses and funds derived from them.

posts.titleVi: Ethereum Price Analysis: ETH Recovers to $2.3K, but Bears Still Eye $2K
posts.summary: Ethereum remains under pressure near $2.3K after its latest recovery failed to reverse the broader downtrend. With the ascending daily channel already lost, attention is shifting toward nearby demand and the liquidation concentrations beneath the market.
posts.summaryVi: Ethereum remains under pressure near $2.3K after its latest recovery failed to reverse the broader downtrend. With the ascending daily channel already lost, attention is shifting toward nearby demand and the liquidation concentrations beneath the market.
posts.content:
Ethereum remains under pressure near $2.3K after its latest recovery failed to reverse the broader downtrend. With the ascending daily channel already lost, attention is shifting toward nearby demand and the liquidation concentrations beneath the market.

The daily chart shows a clear deterioration in Ethereum’s structure following the breakdown below the ascending channel. A subsequent rebound into the $2.44K–$2.52K supply zone was rejected, reinforcing the bearish significance of the broken channel boundary. Since then, ETH has continued to form lower highs and lower lows.

The latest decline produced a sharp wick toward $2.17K, followed by a modest recovery that has struggled to hold above $2.26K. This suggests that buyers are defending the recent lows, but their response has yet to establish a meaningful reversal. The $2.17K–$2.22K region is now an important near-term support area. A sustained break beneath it would expose the psychological $2K level, followed by the broader daily demand zone at approximately $1.82K–$1.98K.

For buyers to improve the outlook, ETH first needs to recover the $2.31K–$2.36K region, where several recent candles consolidated before the latest selloff. However, the more significant barrier remains the $2.44K–$2.52K supply zone. Until that area is reclaimed, recoveries remain vulnerable to renewed selling.

On the four-hour timeframe, Ethereum continues to trade within a descending channel. The recent selloff reached the $2.17K–$2.22K demand zone near the channel’s lower boundary, triggering a rebound toward $2.31K. That recovery was subsequently rejected, leaving the price back around $2.25K.

The failure to sustain the bounce preserves the sequence of lower highs and suggests that sellers remain in control of the short-term structure. Another test of the $2.17K–$2.22K support zone appears plausible if ETH cannot regain the $2.30K–$2.31K area. Repeated pressure on this demand zone could increase the risk of a breakdown, although the recent rejection wick shows that buying interest is still present.

Alternatively, a sustained recovery above $2.31K would bring the descending channel’s upper boundary, currently around $2.35K–$2.38K, into focus. Breaking that trendline would weaken the immediate bearish setup and could allow a broader recovery toward the $2.44K–$2.52K supply zone.

The Binance ETH/USDT liquidation heatmap highlights estimated liquidation concentrations below the current price. A nearby band sits around $2.15K–$2.20K, broadly overlapping the support region identified on the price charts. A larger, brighter concentration is visible around $2K–$2.05K.

This positioning makes the area just above $2K particularly relevant if Ethereum loses its recent lows. A move into these levels could trigger long liquidations and amplify downside volatility. However, the heatmap identifies potential liquidation exposure rather than guaranteed price targets or confirmed buying support.

Above the market, substantial concentrations remain around $2.8K–$3K, but these are distant from the current structure. For now, the nearby downside clusters and repeated failed recoveries keep the focus on support. A recovery above the four-hour descending channel would be the first technical development to ease that pressure.

Wall Street killed Bitcoin’s wild rallies: 10x’s Markus Thielen

Magazine Published Nov 3, 2026 Markus Thielen sees Bitcoin reaching $90,000 by year-end, questions institutional ETF demand and says Ethereum must do more for holders.

Bitcoin’s days of consecutive double-digit price surges are over as Wall Street traders and profit-taking whales reshape the market, according to 10x Research founder Markus Thielen.

Institutional traders selling call options after rallies have made Bitcoin’s violent price explosions of earlier years less common, Thielen says in the latest episode of Cointelegraph’s Trade Secrets .

Thielen is also the author of Crypto Titans , a history of the industry. Writing the book led him to notice how each cycle brought different people pitching crypto to investors.

“Every cycle had actually different promoters, and different promoters bring in different investors,” he says.

This time, the promoters come from Wall Street, where investors trade on economic data and Federal Reserve decisions. Thielen says he expects Bitcoin will rise quickly on news, then spend time crab walking across the chart before the next big macro event.

Written by Nate Kostar staff writer Edited by Ana Paula Pereira staff editor Written by Nate Kostar staff writer Edited by Ana Paula Pereira staff editor

Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool

Latest News Published Nov 3, 2026 Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance’s wallet infrastructure, according to the exchange’s investigation.

A coding assignment from a prospective employer seemed like an ordinary part of a job interview. Instead, it was one step in a months-long cyberattack that ended with $6.3 billion stolen from Binance, raising questions about how exchanges protect themselves against threats that target their employees.

The attack was part of a coordinated campaign that exploited both human vulnerabilities and internal security systems, according to a postmortem released by Binance on Tuesday. The exchange’s findings detailed how hackers gradually gained access to its wallet infrastructure before the Oct. 29 theft.

According to Binance’s security report, the attack campaign began in June, when an engineer downloaded a tampered software package while setting up an AI coding tool. Although Binance detected the malware and replaced the affected device, the attackers had already gathered information about the exchange’s wallet team.

In September, attackers posing as recruiters targeted another software engineer and tricked the employee into downloading a malicious file disguised as a coding assignment. The malware compromised the engineer’s work computer and evaded the exchange’s security protections.

On Oct. 20, the attackers used the compromised computer and an internal AI tool to gain access to two additional engineers’s systems, obtaining deployment credentials that allowed them to install malicious software within Binance’s wallet infrastructure on Oct. 29.

The attackers then gained access to the exchange’s internal wallet-signing service, which authorizes cryptocurrency transactions. This allowed them to move funds outside the normal withdrawal process.

“This wasn’t one mistake or one breach — it was a months-long campaign,” Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said in a Tuesday post on X.

Binance said the attackers also exploited Ethereum’s EIP-7702 mechanism, which allows wallets to delegate transaction permissions to smart contracts, enabling unauthorized transfers to continue even after the exchange suspended withdrawals. Its multiparty computation (MPC) wallet system, which distributes control over transaction signing, complicated efforts to revoke those permissions.

The breach affected approximately $6.3 billion in digital assets , with Binance reporting that $2.85 billion had been frozen or intercepted, according to its latest accounting. The exchange said it would absorb the losses rather than pass them on to customers and had replenished 98% of the affected token assets as of Oct. 31.

The attack, the largest cryptocurrency hack in history, has been attributed to North Korean hackers by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). On Tuesday, Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, denied the country’s involvement , saying the FBI’s attribution was politically motivated and intended to damage North Korea’s international standing.

Binance co-founder Yi He said Tuesday that the exchange’s security team had detected and prevented 57 suspected North Korea-linked cyber threats in 2026, including fraudulent job interviews, malicious software packages and social engineering attempts aimed at stealing credentials or installing malware.

“We intercepted many of them, but the cost of failing to stop even one was severe—and this should never have happened,” she said.

Hong Kong bank pilot opens 24/7 cash settlement for tokenized fund deals

Participating institutions can settle tokenized deposit transactions in central bank money beyond conventional hours, supporting treasury and fund activity.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 EnsembleTX now supports 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenized deposit transactions in tokenized central bank money. 02 The controlled pilot involves 12 banks and 20 industry pioneers, with access dependent on participating institutions. 03 Trials involving regulated stablecoins remain forthcoming, separate from the upgraded settlement capability already available within the EnsembleTX pilot. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Hong Kong's tokenization pilot now lets participating banks settle tokenized deposit transactions around the clock in central bank money, extending the cash settlement behind corporate treasury and tokenized-fund activity beyond conventional operating hours.

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced the upgrade on Nov. 2. EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, now has 12 participating banks and 20 industry pioneers.

The customer deposits and the settlement money have different roles. Participating firms use tokenized deposits supplied by commercial banks; tokenized central bank money settles the transactions between banks. The upgrade extends the hours available for that interbank cash settlement.

Related Reading Central banks map their role in a payments system shared with stablecoins

Participating industry pioneers have already used bank-provided tokenized deposits for corporate treasury management and tokenized money market fund transactions. HKMA names Ant International, BlackRock and China Asset Management (Hong Kong) among the firms involved.

Banks providing tokenized deposits for the cited activity include Bank of China (Hong Kong), China Construction Bank (Asia), ICBC (Asia), Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) and HSBC. These are examples given by HKMA, rather than the full roster of 12 participating banks.

For a corporate treasury using the pilot, the practical change is that its participating bank can settle the relevant transactions outside conventional operating hours. Tokenized-fund users gain extended cash-settlement availability where their banks and platforms support the activity.

Securities and Futures Commission Chief Executive Julia Leung said the capability supports round-the-clock corporate treasury transactions and secondary trading of tokenized funds on licensed platforms. Availability for an individual fund still depends on the bank and platform arrangements; continuous interbank settlement does not establish continuous trading for every fund.

Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’

Markets Published Nov 3, 2026 Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

Bitcoin (BTC) headed higher at Tuesday’s Wall Street open as a tech-stock rebound under the shadow of uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections.

Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD circling $77,000, continuing to retain local lows near $76,300 seen on Friday.

BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

Stocks faced conflicting forces at the start of the US trading session. Apple shares sought to pare losses after falling 4% in premarket trading as the company forecast gross margins of 45% to 46% for the December quarter, down from 47.9% in the previous quarter, citing rising memory-chip costs.

Markets also weighed the potential impact of the US midterm elections on the balance of power in Congress. Although polls suggested significant Democratic gains, some analysts cautioned that the results could be less decisive than expected.

Apple stock one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

“Investors seem to have a significant dose of skepticism about whether the final outcome is going to be quite as favorable to Democrats as the polling suggests,” Tobin Marcus, head of US policy and politics at equity research company Wolfe Research, told CNBC. Wolfe added that polls were “likely overstating Democratic strength.”

The S&P 500 and tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index finished Monday down 0.5% and 1.1%, respectively. Analysts at trading resource The Kobeissi Letter argued that US political uncertainty, rather than concerns over AI spending alone, was driving market weakness.

“The reality is that the market is pricing-in a major shift in the political landscape of the US,” it wrote on X.

The analysis suggested that a divided Congress could lead to frequent legislative impasses, creating conditions in which policy decisions would become less predictable.

“A change in the political landscape always comes with uncertainty; markets hate uncertainty,” it continued.

Nasdaq Composite Index one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

Related: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater

Oil prices meanwhile brushed off a US attack on Iran’s Qeshm Island, a key military control outpost for the Strait of Hormuz oil route.

The move came just days after US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that President Donald Trump was open to resolving the US-Iran war “diplomatically,” comments that triggered a 7% drop in WTI crude oil on Monday.

WTI initially jumped to $98.80 per barrel before dipping below $94 on Tuesday, hitting its lowest level since Oct. 15.

CFDs on WTI crude oil one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView

Bitcoin and Treasury yields fall together in rare divergence as $80,000 recovery fails

Bitcoin dropped 8.25% while real yields declined 16 basis points, raising questions about why a historically supportive macroeconomic shift has offered little relief.

By Oluwapelumi Adejumo Senior Reporter • CryptoSlate

01 Bitcoin fell 8.25% between Oct. 21 and Oct. 30 despite a 16-basis-point decline in US real Treasury yields, which typically support non-yielding assets. 02 Technology-stock weakness, $1 billion in Bitcoin ETF outflows and leveraged liquidations have overwhelmed the potential benefits of falling yields. 03 Wintermute warns that Bitcoin must defend $76,800 or risk deeper losses, while a sustained recovery above $80,000 requires renewed spot demand. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Bitcoin is struggling to recover despite falling US Treasury yields, as technology-stock weakness and persistent ETF withdrawals weigh on demand.

Between Oct. 21 and Oct. 30, the world's largest cryptocurrency declined 8.25%, falling from approximately $84,134 to $77,191, according to CryptoSlate's data.

Over the same period, the Federal Reserve's data shows that yields on 10-year inflation-protected US Treasuries fell from 2.76% to 2.60%, down 16 basis points. The Nasdaq-100 also lost 4.82%, reflecting mounting pressure on technology stocks.

The divergence is notable because lower real Treasury yields typically reduce the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets such as Bitcoin. However, selling pressure across crypto and parts of the equity market has overwhelmed that potential support.

The weakness continued into November. On Nov. 2, the Nasdaq-100 declined another 1.39%, while Bitcoin's daily Coinbase price observation fell 1.34% to approximately $77,062 from the previous day.

Bitcoin was trading near $76,861 early Tuesday, leaving it below the psychologically important $80,000 level.

Bitfinex attributed the weakness to declining technology shares and subdued spot-market demand, arguing that those pressures were overwhelming the potential support from falling real Treasury yields.

The selling pressure was compounded by Binance's Oct. 29 security breach, which crypto trading firm Wintermute identified as the dominant crypto-specific shock behind last week's downturn .

The incident struck an already fragile market, triggering about $1.5 billion in crypto liquidations, with long positions accounting for approximately 85% of the total.

Related Reading Bitcoin’s recovery faces rising derivatives exposure and $643 million in ETF outflows

Wintermute said traders had attempted to buy the decline primarily through leveraged perpetual futures rather than sustained spot purchases. As prices continued falling, those positions faced further liquidation, deepening the downturn.

The firm warned that there was little evidence of fresh capital entering the market to support a durable recovery.

Bitcoin faces $76,800 test as ETF withdrawals accelerate

The weakness has also extended to US-listed spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds, which recorded $398.6 million in net outflows on Nov. 2, according to Farside Investors .

BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust accounted for $405.3 million in withdrawals, partially offset by $6.7 million in inflows into Fidelity's FBTC.

That followed $643.2 million in ETF outflows on Oct. 30, bringing total net withdrawals across the two trading sessions to approximately $1.04 billion.

The sustained redemptions have added to concerns about Bitcoin's ability to recover, particularly as Wintermute's analysis suggests that recent buying has been concentrated in leveraged derivatives rather than supported by substantial new spot-market capital.

[8] Reported statement Wintermute said that reclaiming $80,000 with spot and ETF demand would challenge its cautious outlook, while the 50-week moving average near $76,800 was the next downside level to hold. Coinbase Bitcoin observations and Nasdaq closing times differ. The yield series had no Nov. 2 observation in the cited snapshot. The data describe co-movement and dated flows, not proven causality; the ETF bars show only two trading sessions.

Wintermute identified $80,000 as the key level Bitcoin must reclaim to reverse its cautious near-term outlook. It said any sustained recovery would need to be supported by stronger demand in spot markets and ETF inflows.

On the downside, the firm identified Bitcoin's 50-week moving average near $76,800 as the next critical support level, warning that a sustained break below it would strengthen the bearish case.

The outlook now depends partly on upcoming US economic releases , including September job openings data on Nov. 3 and the October employment report on Nov. 6.

Both reports could influence Treasury yields and expectations for Federal Reserve policy. But even another decline in real yields may offer limited relief if technology shares remain under pressure and Bitcoin ETF investors continue withdrawing funds.

A sustained move below $76,800 would leave Wintermute reassessing the downside risks, while a recovery above $80,000 backed by renewed spot buying would challenge its cautious outlook.

posts.summary: The cryptocurrency market was hit hard by the recent $6.3 billion Binance hack, yet Hyperliquid’s native token defied the broader pullback and posted a nearly 10% gain over the past week.

posts.content:
The cryptocurrency market was hit hard by the recent $6.3 billion Binance hack, yet Hyperliquid’s native token defied the broader pullback and posted a nearly 10% gain over the past week.

However, one popular analyst warned that the asset could soon nosedive by double digits, while a key factor supports the bearish scenario.

As of press time, HYPE is changing hands just below $85, down from the local peak of about $96 recorded before the Binance incident. Nonetheless, it remains firmly in the green on both the weekly and fortnightly timeframes.

According to Ali Martinez, though, the asset is forming a potential head-and-shoulders top on the 12-hour chart, pointing to a possible 22% correction. He went even further, suggesting that a sustained close below the $76-$78 neckline could be followed by a crash toward a 10-week low of $59.

The analyst believes a recovery above the right shoulder’s high of the structure, at near $90, would weaken the bearish setup. “The pattern isn’t confirmed until Hyperliquid breaks support. A bounce from $76–$78 could keep the formation from playing out,” he added.

FOUR | Crypto Spaces also presented a pessimistic view. The analyst warned that the recent weakness has tilted the balance in favor of the bears, arguing that a drop below $77 could trigger a collapse toward $60.

Token Talk, for their part, claimed HYPE has reached a critical juncture, identifying the $76-$77 range as a key support zone bulls need to defend.

“If we keep bouncing between these levels, cool. But if support finally gives up, I don’t think the downside is going to be pretty,” they stated.

According to CoinGlass, HYPE has recorded positive exchange netflows for six consecutive days, indicating that more tokens have been moved to centralized platforms than withdrawn to self-custody wallets. This development is typically interpreted as bearish since it increases immediate selling pressure.

Exchange netflows have been a hot topic lately. Somewhat expected, the $6.3 billion Binance hack undermined the credibility of the world’s leading crypto exchange and led to massive outflows. Once withdrawals were restored, users pulled nearly $4.65 billion from the platform in under 10 hours, far exceeding the roughly $1 billion in deposits recorded over the same period.

Latest data shows that Binance’s netflows for the last seven days have reached almost -$12 billion, while some of its competitors saw significant inflows and increased their market share. OKX, for instance, attracted roughly $360 million in net flows over the past week, while Bybit recorded approximately $140 million.

posts.content:
Bitcoin Lightning fix blocks a probe linking private channels to onchain funding

LDK’s fix blocks a funding-location probe that required connections to both endpoints of an unannounced channel.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 LDK has a fix for an onion-message probe that could link an unannounced channel to its Bitcoin funding output. 02 Successful probing required connections to both suspected endpoints and a guessed real short-channel ID derived from the funding output. 03 Valid aliases remain usable. Which wallet releases and deployments include the fix still needs confirmation. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

Lightning Development Kit (LDK), software used to build Bitcoin Lightning applications, has a privacy fix that blocks a documented probe linking an unannounced channel to the Bitcoin output backing it. The probe exploited how LDK forwarded onion messages, turning a guessed channel identifier into confirmation of a connection between two suspected nodes.

Bitcoin Optech highlighted the change on October 30 . An unannounced channel stays out of the public network map, but that alone did not prevent LDK’s message-forwarding lookup from confirming its funding link.

Related Reading Core Lightning patches critical security flaws and a Bitcoin payment bug

A real short-channel ID, or SCID, works like blockchain coordinates. The Lightning specification defines it using the block height, the transaction’s position within that block and the output’s position within that transaction. Together, those identify the particular Bitcoin output funding a channel.

An attacker can derive a candidate ID from an output’s location without yet knowing whether it belongs to a channel between the suspected nodes. The documented probe supplies that missing confirmation. It requires the attacker to connect to both endpoints and construct an onion-message path through them that returns to the attacker.

Before the fix, LDK’s channel lookup could resolve a real SCID even for an unannounced channel once its funding confirmed. If the message returned successfully, the attacker could confirm that the guessed output and the channel between those nodes matched.

How a guessed ID can expose a hidden funding link

Compare the documented onion-message probe before and after LDK’s October 25 code fix.

A real channel ID encodes a funding output’s location THE ID IS A SET OF BLOCKCHAIN COORDINATES Block height Transaction index Output index Real SCID Funding location The probe asks: does this output fund a channel between these nodes? Block, transaction and output identify the real SCID THE FUNDING LOCATION Block Transaction Output Real short-channel ID Does this output fund a channel between the suspected nodes?

Where the probe stops Before the fix After the fix A returned message confirms the candidate funding-output link under the documented probe conditions.

Before fix: returned message confirms funding link CONDITION: THE ATTACKER CONNECTS TO BOTH ENDPOINTS Attacker Node A Node B Guessed real SCID Unannounced channel Message forwarded Onion message returns to the attacker Successful return confirms the candidate funding link. Before fix: message goes through A and B back to attacker Connected to both endpoints Attacker Node A Node B Guessed real SCID Unannounced channel: A to B Return confirms funding link

LDK rejects the unannounced channel’s real SCID unless it is the outbound alias. Valid aliases remain usable.

After fix: real-ID lookup rejected CONDITION: THE ATTACKER CONNECTS TO BOTH ENDPOINTS Attacker Node A Node B Guessed real SCID Unannounced channel Node A rejects real-ID lookup Unless that value is the outbound alias Valid aliases remain usable. After fix: guessed real-ID lookup stops at node A Connected to both endpoints Attacker Node A Node B Guessed real SCID Channel A to B Node A rejects real-ID lookup Exception: value is outbound alias Valid aliases still work

LDK blocks the unannounced channel’s real-ID lookup; valid aliases remain usable.

Requires attacker connections to both suspected endpoints and a candidate real SCID. Rejection excepts a value equal to the outbound alias. The merge does not establish release inclusion or deployed wallet coverage.

LDK PR 5314: mechanism and fix BOLT 7: real short-channel ID definition Bitcoin Optech: documented privacy probe Official changelog: release-scope context Supporting facts

In the documented probe, an unrelated peer connected to both suspected channel endpoints can use a guessed real short-channel ID in an onion-message path through those nodes back to itself; successful receipt confirms the candidate channel’s funding-output link. [1] [3] A real short-channel ID encodes the funding output’s blockchain location: the block height, the transaction’s position inside that block, and the output’s position inside the transaction. [2] Before the fix, LDK’s ChannelManager lookup could resolve real IDs of unannounced channels after their funding confirmed, so omitting a channel from public gossip did not prevent this onion-message lookup from confirming its onchain location. [1] [3] The fix rejects a real short-channel ID for an unannounced channel during onion-message next-node lookup unless that value is the channel’s outbound alias, while leaving valid aliases usable. [1] [3] This fix concerns onion-message forwarding; the PR explicitly makes the lookup stricter than an HTLC payment-relay path that can permit real IDs for some private channels under configuration. [1] [3] The reviewed PR and technical summary demonstrate a funding-output link to suspected channel endpoints; they provide no evidence of stolen bitcoin, compromised private keys, unrelated wallet holdings being revealed, or exposure of every Lightning channel. [1] [3] The October 25 merge establishes a source-code fix; the reviewed official changelog does not establish a release or deployed wallet version containing it. [1] [4] Method

Schematic of the documented lookup and message path. Arrows represent onion messages, not bitcoin transfers. Before/after panels describe code behavior; positions and lengths are not measurements.

Requires attacker connections to both suspected endpoints and a candidate real SCID. Rejection excepts a value equal to the outbound alias. The merge does not establish release inclusion or deployed wallet coverage.

The demonstrated leak therefore joins two pieces of information: a Bitcoin funding output and the Lightning nodes using it.

Related Reading Lightning apps using unpatched LDK risk Bitcoin theft from a reconnect lie

LDK now refuses to resolve an unannounced channel’s real SCID for onion-message forwarding. Valid aliases remain usable as alternative identifiers, so a sender can address the channel without using its real blockchain coordinates. The change closes this lookup route while preserving forwarding that uses an allowed alias.

The change is described in the pull request . Under BOLT 4’s onion-routing rules , an onion-message SCID must correspond to an announced identifier or a local alias.

The fix’s inclusion in installed wallet versions remains unverified. Users need confirmation from their wallet provider before assuming installed software has this protection.

Related Reading Eclair tightens Bitcoin funding rules after unconfirmed inputs put Lightning payments at risk

posts.content:
Ripple mở khóa 1,25 tỷ USD XRP rồi nhanh chóng khóa lại 700 triệu token

Ripple khóa lại 700 triệu XRP sau đợt mở khóa tháng 11

Ripple đã đưa 700 triệu XRP trở lại escrow sau khi mở khóa 1 tỷ XRP vào ngày 1/11, tương đương khoảng 1,25 tỷ USD theo giá tại thời điểm đó.

Dữ liệu on-chain cho thấy ba hợp đồng escrow mới lần lượt chứa 100 triệu XRP, 500 triệu XRP và 100 triệu XRP .

Hai hợp đồng đầu, tổng cộng 600 triệu XRP, có thể được mở khóa từ ngày 1/6/2029 , trong khi 100 triệu XRP còn lại được lên lịch cho ngày 1/7/2029 .

Sau các giao dịch này, lượng XRP thực sự rời khỏi escrow trong tháng 11 chỉ còn 300 triệu XRP .

300 triệu XRP ngoài escrow không đồng nghĩa bị bán

Điểm cần lưu ý là việc token được mở khóa chỉ có nghĩa số XRP đó không còn nằm trong hợp đồng khóa thời gian.

Điều này không chứng minh Ripple đã chuyển 300 triệu XRP lên sàn hoặc bán ra thị trường .

Muốn xác định hoạt động bán, cần theo dõi các giao dịch tiếp theo từ ví Ripple tới sàn, tổ chức hoặc các địa chỉ khác.

Theo XRP Insights, sau chu kỳ mới nhất, khoảng 31,1 tỷ XRP vẫn đang bị khóa trong 99 hợp đồng escrow do Ripple kiểm soát .

Trong 12 chu kỳ mở khóa gần nhất, Ripple đã giải phóng 12 tỷ XRP nhưng khóa trở lại khoảng 8,4 tỷ XRP, tương đương 70% .

https://twitter.com/noolanded/status/21173110915921

Thị trường tiếp tục theo dõi nguồn cung XRP

Cơ chế escrow được Ripple triển khai từ năm 2017 nhằm giúp lịch phân phối XRP trở nên dễ dự đoán hơn.

Lượng 3,6 tỷ XRP không được khóa trở lại trong 12 tháng qua phản ánh mức giảm của nguồn cung bị khóa, nhưng vẫn không đồng nghĩa toàn bộ số token này đã đi vào lưu thông công khai.

Diễn biến này xuất hiện khi XRP đang giao dịch quanh 1,26 USD , sau giai đoạn thị trường crypto suy yếu trong tháng 10.

Vì vậy, điều nhà đầu tư cần theo dõi không chỉ là số XRP được mở khóa mỗi tháng, mà còn là bao nhiêu token được Ripple khóa trở lại và dòng XRP còn lại thực sự được chuyển đi đâu .

Ripple mở khóa 1,25 tỷ USD XRP rồi nhanh chóng khóa lại 700 triệu token

Ripple khóa lại 700 triệu XRP sau đợt mở khóa tháng 11

Ripple đã đưa 700 triệu XRP trở lại escrow sau khi mở khóa 1 tỷ XRP vào ngày 1/11, tương đương khoảng 1,25 tỷ USD theo giá tại thời điểm đó.

Dữ liệu on-chain cho thấy ba hợp đồng escrow mới lần lượt chứa 100 triệu XRP, 500 triệu XRP và 100 triệu XRP .

Hai hợp đồng đầu, tổng cộng 600 triệu XRP, có thể được mở khóa từ ngày 1/6/2029 , trong khi 100 triệu XRP còn lại được lên lịch cho ngày 1/7/2029 .

Sau các giao dịch này, lượng XRP thực sự rời khỏi escrow trong tháng 11 chỉ còn 300 triệu XRP .

300 triệu XRP ngoài escrow không đồng nghĩa bị bán

Điểm cần lưu ý là việc token được mở khóa chỉ có nghĩa số XRP đó không còn nằm trong hợp đồng khóa thời gian.

Điều này không chứng minh Ripple đã chuyển 300 triệu XRP lên sàn hoặc bán ra thị trường .

Muốn xác định hoạt động bán, cần theo dõi các giao dịch tiếp theo từ ví Ripple tới sàn, tổ chức hoặc các địa chỉ khác.

Theo XRP Insights, sau chu kỳ mới nhất, khoảng 31,1 tỷ XRP vẫn đang bị khóa trong 99 hợp đồng escrow do Ripple kiểm soát .

Trong 12 chu kỳ mở khóa gần nhất, Ripple đã giải phóng 12 tỷ XRP nhưng khóa trở lại khoảng 8,4 tỷ XRP, tương đương 70% .

https://twitter.com/noolanded/status/21173110915921

Thị trường tiếp tục theo dõi nguồn cung XRP

Cơ chế escrow được Ripple triển khai từ năm 2017 nhằm giúp lịch phân phối XRP trở nên dễ dự đoán hơn.

Lượng 3,6 tỷ XRP không được khóa trở lại trong 12 tháng qua phản ánh mức giảm của nguồn cung bị khóa, nhưng vẫn không đồng nghĩa toàn bộ số token này đã đi vào lưu thông công khai.

Diễn biến này xuất hiện khi XRP đang giao dịch quanh 1,26 USD , sau giai đoạn thị trường crypto suy yếu trong tháng 10.

Vì vậy, điều nhà đầu tư cần theo dõi không chỉ là số XRP được mở khóa mỗi tháng, mà còn là bao nhiêu token được Ripple khóa trở lại và dòng XRP còn lại thực sự được chuyển đi đâu .

Stronger US factory activity complicates Bitcoin’s hopes for lower rates

ISM’s production index reached 59 as factory price increases became less widespread, leaving growth and funding signals in tension.

By Liam 'Akiba' Wright Editor-in-Chief • CryptoSlate

01 ISM’s October production index reached 59, its highest since November 2021, while manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5. 02 ISM’s prices index fell to 75.2 from 77.9, tempering the factory-cost signal without resolving Bitcoin’s rate outlook. 03 After the Fed’s divided hold, stronger activity could support Bitcoin risk appetite while persistent costs complicate the case for rate relief. Make CryptoSlate preferred on Share

U.S. manufacturers’ production gauge reached its highest reading since November 2021 in October, giving Bitcoin investors a stronger growth signal alongside persistent factory cost pressure. The combination could complicate the case for easier U.S. interest rates even as firmer activity could support appetite for risk.

The Institute for Supply Management’s report released November 2 put its production index at 59, up from September’s 56.7. The headline manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 from 54.5, marking a tenth consecutive month of expansion in the survey.

The prices index moved in the opposite direction, falling to 75.2 from 77.9. That is a meaningful counterweight to the stronger production reading: raw-material price increases became less widespread. Yet October still marked the 25th consecutive month of rising raw-material prices.

Related Reading Bitcoin catches a break from falling oil prices, but OPEC+ raises new Fed concerns

These are diffusion indexes , which measure the breadth of monthly changes across respondents. The production milestone concerns a survey reading, not the physical level of factory output. Likewise, the prices index measures how widespread increases are, rather than the inflation rate.

ISM’s October production index rose as its prices index eased. The combination leaves Bitcoin with competing growth and funding signals.

Hammack preferred a quarter-point increase. [2] Stronger factory activity could support confidence and risk appetite, but continued cost increases could also make an easier-rate outlook harder to justify; these are competing interpretations of the ISM and Fed evidence, not observed Bitcoin price effects. The production milestone refers to an index, not physical output. The prices index fell while raw-material prices still rose. Bitcoin channels are analytical possibilities, not measured effects. The Fed held rates; two dissents did not enact a hike.

The Federal Reserve held its target range at 3.75%–4% on October 28, citing strong economic activity and elevated inflation. The decision passed 10–2, with Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack preferring a quarter-point increase.

Related Reading The Fed's rate freeze will mean nothing unless banks fix a repo market bottleneck

A 2023 IMF working paper found that Fed tightening reduces a common crypto-price factor through the risk-taking channel, meaning changes in investors’ willingness to hold risky assets. That historical result helps explain why the rate outlook matters for crypto.

For the rates outlook, the next distinction is whether investors expect borrowing costs to stay high. Firmer expectations for short-term rates would reinforce the restrictive-funding interpretation; falling yields alongside resilient Bitcoin demand would weaken it.

Hoạt động mạnh mẽ hơn của nhà máy ở Hoa Kỳ làm phức tạp thêm hy vọng của Bitcoin về tỷ giá thấp hơn

Chỉ số sản xuất của ISM đạt 59 khi việc tăng giá xuất xưởng trở nên ít phổ biến hơn, khiến các tín hiệu tăng trưởng và tài trợ trở nên căng thẳng.

Bởi Liam 'Akiba' Wright Tổng biên tập • CryptoSlate

Chỉ số sản xuất tháng 10 của ISM đạt 59, cao nhất kể từ tháng 11 năm 2021, trong khi PMI sản xuất tăng lên 55,5. Chỉ số giá của ISM vào ngày 02 tháng 10 đã giảm xuống 75,2 từ 77,9, làm dịu tín hiệu chi phí sản xuất mà không giải quyết được triển vọng tỷ giá của Bitcoin. 03 Sau khi Fed chia quyền nắm giữ, hoạt động mạnh mẽ hơn có thể hỗ trợ khẩu vị rủi ro Bitcoin trong khi chi phí dai dẳng làm phức tạp thêm trường hợp giảm lãi suất. Đặt CryptoSlate được ưu tiên trên Chia sẻ

Chỉ số sản xuất của các nhà sản xuất Hoa Kỳ đạt mức cao nhất kể từ tháng 11 năm 2021 vào tháng 10, mang đến cho các nhà đầu tư Bitcoin tín hiệu tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ hơn bên cạnh áp lực chi phí nhà máy dai dẳng. Sự kết hợp này có thể làm phức tạp thêm trường hợp nới lỏng lãi suất của Hoa Kỳ ngay cả khi hoạt động vững chắc hơn có thể hỗ trợ khẩu vị rủi ro.

Báo cáo của Viện Quản lý Cung ứng công bố ngày 2 tháng 11 đưa chỉ số sản xuất của họ lên mức 59, tăng so với mức 56,7 của tháng 9. Chỉ số PMI sản xuất toàn phần tăng lên 55,5 từ 54,5, đánh dấu tháng mở rộng thứ mười liên tiếp trong cuộc khảo sát.

Chỉ số giá di chuyển theo hướng ngược lại, giảm xuống 75,2 từ 77,9. Đó là một đối trọng có ý nghĩa đối với kết quả sản xuất mạnh mẽ hơn: việc tăng giá nguyên liệu thô trở nên ít phổ biến hơn. Tuy nhiên, tháng 10 vẫn đánh dấu tháng thứ 25 liên tiếp giá nguyên liệu thô tăng.

Đọc liên quan Bitcoin thoát khỏi sự sụt giảm của giá dầu, nhưng OPEC + làm tăng mối lo ngại mới của Fed

Đây là các chỉ số phổ biến, đo lường mức độ thay đổi hàng tháng của những người trả lời. Cột mốc sản xuất liên quan đến kết quả khảo sát chứ không phải mức sản lượng thực tế của nhà máy. Tương tự như vậy, chỉ số giá đo lường mức độ gia tăng trên diện rộng, thay vì tỷ lệ lạm phát.

Một tài liệu làm việc của IMF năm 2023 cho thấy việc thắt chặt của Fed làm giảm yếu tố giá tiền điện tử phổ biến thông qua kênh chấp nhận rủi ro, nghĩa là những thay đổi trong mức độ sẵn sàng nắm giữ tài sản rủi ro của các nhà đầu tư. Kết quả lịch sử đó giúp giải thích tại sao triển vọng tỷ giá lại quan trọng đối với tiền điện tử.

Đối với triển vọng lãi suất, điểm khác biệt tiếp theo là liệu các nhà đầu tư có kỳ vọng chi phí đi vay sẽ ở mức cao hay không. Những kỳ vọng vững chắc hơn về lãi suất ngắn hạn sẽ củng cố cách giải thích về nguồn tài trợ hạn chế; Lợi suất giảm cùng với nhu cầu Bitcoin kiên cường sẽ làm suy yếu nó.

What’s at stake for crypto as the US votes in the 2026 midterms?

Latest News Published Nov 3, 2026 Crypto groups spent about $176 million ahead of the US midterms, with control of Congress and the future of crypto legislation at stake.

US voters head to the polls in midterm elections on Tuesday that could shift control of Congress and shape the future of cryptocurrency regulation.

Crypto industry groups have spent roughly $176 million across more than 100 races this election cycle, according to an Oct. 27 Reuters report.

Coinbase, Ripple and Andreessen Horowitz are among the main financiers of the Fairshake political network.

The results could reshape the prospects for the stalled CLARITY Act and determine which lawmakers lead committees overseeing the industry.

Republicans enter Tuesday’s midterms controlling both chambers of Congress, with 219 seats in the House of Representatives and 53 in the Senate, according to the Blockchain Association’s election dashboard.

Democrats are seeking to overturn those majorities, with prediction markets favoring the party to win the House and Senate, according to Kalshi data at the time of publishing.

Voters will decide all 435 House seats and 35 Senate races, determining which party controls Congress for the final two years of President Donald Trump’s second term.

Democratic control could bring more congressional scrutiny of Trump-linked crypto businesses and regulators’ decisions. Control of the Senate would also affect confirmation of future presidential nominees to regulatory posts.

Ohio’s Senate race between Republican Jon Husted and Democrat Sherrod Brown is a major test of crypto’s political influence. Industry groups have reportedly spent more than $50 million opposing Brown, a longtime crypto critic who could return to a senior Senate committee role.

In Nebraska, Republican Sen. Pete Ricketts faces independent Dan Osborn. Ricketts, a Senate Banking Committee member who has supported crypto-friendly legislation, has benefited from nearly $11 million in spending by Fairshake, according to the Washington Examiner.

Texas is another race to watch, with Republican Ken Paxton facing Democrat James Talarico in a closely contested Senate election. As Cointelegraph previously reported , the Winklevoss-backed Digital Freedom Fund has spent money supporting Paxton.

A shift in congressional control could delay the CLARITY Act, although the crypto market structure bill has already struggled under Republican leadership.

The legislation would divide oversight of crypto markets between the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, as well as establish rules for intermediaries. The Senate failed to advance it in a 49–50 procedural vote on Sept. 15, short of the 60 votes required.

Democratic Sen. Mark Warner cited insufficient safeguards against Trump profiting from his administration’s crypto policies. Republican sponsors said their final draft incorporated substantial ethics concessions sought by Democrats.

“A change in control of Congress would most likely reset the timetable for the CLARITY Act,” Christian Davies, group head of innovation and digital capital at Relm Insurance, told Cointelegraph.

Related: Crypto PAC spending before midterms possibly obscured after reported FEC hack

Ryan Kirkley, CEO of Global Settlement Network, agreed that the challenges extend beyond party control.

“The CLARITY Act was already struggling to get through the Senate with Republicans in control, so clearly the problem goes beyond which party holds the majority,” Kirkley said.

The industry has already secured a federal stablecoin framework through the GENIUS Act, which became law in July 2025.

Bitcoin’s (BTC) price history around US midterms has attracted attention on social media, but analysts caution that past declines offer little guidance on what could happen after Tuesday’s vote.

Bitcoin fell below earlier yearly lows after the 2014, 2018 and 2022 midterms. Source: ManGana

“I’d be careful reading much into Bitcoin’s record after past midterms. There haven’t been enough cycles to call it a pattern, and the market is built differently now: ETF flows, institutional portfolios and global liquidity move the price far more than they used to,” Michael Heinrich, CEO and co-founder of 0G Labs, told Cointelegraph.

Related: From Uptober to Hacktober: Are Bitcoin’s seasonal patterns becoming obsolete?

GSN’s Kirkley said institutional flows, interest rate expectations and market liquidity were more immediate factors affecting Bitcoin.

“Bitcoin doesn’t need a particular election result to succeed. It needs capital, confidence and a macro environment that gives investors a reason to take risk again,” Kirkley said.

Điều gì đang bị đe dọa đối với tiền điện tử khi Hoa Kỳ bỏ phiếu trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ năm 2026?

Tin tức mới nhất được xuất bản vào ngày 3 tháng 11 năm 2026 Các nhóm tiền điện tử đã chi khoảng 176 triệu đô la trước cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Hoa Kỳ, với sự kiểm soát của Quốc hội và tương lai của luật pháp về tiền điện tử đang bị đe dọa.

Cử tri Hoa Kỳ sẽ tham gia các cuộc bỏ phiếu trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ vào thứ Ba, điều này có thể thay đổi quyền kiểm soát của Quốc hội và định hình tương lai của quy định về tiền điện tử.

Theo báo cáo ngày 27 tháng 10 của Reuters, các nhóm ngành công nghiệp tiền điện tử đã chi khoảng 176 triệu USD cho hơn 100 cuộc đua trong chu kỳ bầu cử này.

Coinbase, Ripple và Andreessen Horowitz là một trong những nhà tài trợ chính của mạng lưới chính trị Fairshake.

Kết quả có thể định hình lại triển vọng cho Đạo luật CLARITY đang bị đình trệ và xác định nhà lập pháp nào đứng đầu ủy ban giám sát ngành.

Đảng Cộng hòa bước vào cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ vào thứ Ba để kiểm soát cả hai viện của Quốc hội, với 219 ghế tại Hạ viện và 53 ghế tại Thượng viện, theo bảng điều khiển bầu cử của Hiệp hội Blockchain.

Theo dữ liệu của Kalshi tại thời điểm xuất bản, các đảng viên Đảng Dân chủ đang tìm cách lật đổ đa số đó, với thị trường dự đoán ủng hộ đảng này giành được Hạ viện và Thượng viện.

Cử tri sẽ quyết định tất cả 435 ghế Hạ viện và 35 ghế Thượng viện, xác định đảng nào kiểm soát Quốc hội trong hai năm cuối cùng trong nhiệm kỳ thứ hai của Tổng thống Donald Trump.

Sự kiểm soát của đảng Dân chủ có thể mang lại sự giám sát chặt chẽ hơn của Quốc hội đối với các quyết định của cơ quan quản lý và doanh nghiệp tiền điện tử có liên quan đến Trump. Việc kiểm soát Thượng viện cũng sẽ ảnh hưởng đến việc xác nhận các ứng cử viên tổng thống trong tương lai vào các vị trí quản lý.

Cuộc đua vào Thượng viện Ohio giữa đảng viên Cộng hòa Jon Husted và đảng viên Đảng Dân chủ Sherrod Brown là một thử thách lớn về ảnh hưởng chính trị của tiền điện tử. Các nhóm ngành được cho là đã chi hơn 50 triệu đô la để phản đối Brown, một nhà phê bình tiền điện tử lâu năm, người có thể trở lại vai trò ủy ban cấp cao của Thượng viện.

Tại Nebraska, Thượng nghị sĩ đảng Cộng hòa Pete Ricketts đối mặt với Dan Osborn độc lập. Ricketts, thành viên Ủy ban Ngân hàng Thượng viện, người đã ủng hộ luật thân thiện với tiền điện tử, đã được hưởng lợi từ khoản chi gần 11 triệu USD của Fairshake, theo Washington Examiner.

Texas là một cuộc đua khác đáng theo dõi, với Ken Paxton của Đảng Cộng hòa đối đầu với James Talarico của Đảng Dân chủ trong một cuộc bầu cử Thượng viện đầy tranh cãi. Như Cointelegraph đã đưa tin trước đây, Quỹ Tự do Kỹ thuật số được Winklevoss hậu thuẫn đã chi tiền hỗ trợ Paxton.

Sự thay đổi trong quyền kiểm soát của quốc hội có thể trì hoãn Đạo luật CLARITY, mặc dù dự luật cấu trúc thị trường tiền điện tử đã gặp khó khăn dưới sự lãnh đạo của Đảng Cộng hòa.Luật pháp sẽ phân chia việc giám sát thị trường tiền điện tử giữa Ủy ban Chứng khoán và Giao dịch và Ủy ban Giao dịch Hàng hóa Tương lai Hàng hóa, cũng như thiết lập các quy tắc cho các bên trung gian. Thượng viện đã không thể thông qua nó trong cuộc bỏ phiếu theo thủ tục 49–50 vào ngày 15 tháng 9, thiếu 60 phiếu cần thiết.

Thượng nghị sĩ Đảng Dân chủ Mark Warner đã trích dẫn các biện pháp bảo vệ không đủ để chống lại việc Trump thu lợi từ các chính sách về tiền điện tử của chính quyền ông. Các nhà tài trợ của Đảng Cộng hòa cho biết dự thảo cuối cùng của họ đã đưa ra những nhượng bộ đáng kể về mặt đạo đức mà Đảng Dân chủ đang tìm kiếm.

Christian Davies, người đứng đầu nhóm đổi mới và vốn kỹ thuật số tại Relm Insurance, nói với Cointelegraph: “Một sự thay đổi trong quyền kiểm soát của Quốc hội rất có thể sẽ đặt lại thời gian biểu cho Đạo luật CLARITY”.

Liên quan: Chi tiêu tiền điện tử PAC trước kỳ giữa kỳ có thể bị che khuất sau vụ hack FEC được báo cáo

Ryan Kirkley, Giám đốc điều hành của Mạng lưới Định cư Toàn cầu, đồng ý rằng những thách thức vượt ra ngoài tầm kiểm soát của đảng.

Kirkley nói: “Đạo luật CLARITY vốn đã gặp khó khăn để thông qua Thượng viện với sự kiểm soát của đảng Cộng hòa, vì vậy rõ ràng vấn đề nằm ngoài việc đảng nào chiếm đa số”.

Ngành công nghiệp này đã bảo đảm khuôn khổ stablecoin liên bang thông qua Đạo luật GENIUS, trở thành luật vào tháng 7 năm 2025.

Lịch sử giá của Bitcoin (BTC) trong các cuộc bầu cử giữa nhiệm kỳ của Hoa Kỳ đã thu hút sự chú ý trên mạng xã hội, nhưng các nhà phân tích cảnh báo rằng những đợt sụt giảm trong quá khứ đưa ra rất ít hướng dẫn về những gì có thể xảy ra sau cuộc bỏ phiếu hôm thứ Ba.

Bitcoin đã giảm xuống dưới mức thấp hàng năm trước đó sau các cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ năm 2014, 2018 và 2022. Nguồn: ManGana

Michael Heinrich, Giám đốc điều hành và đồng sáng lập của 0G Labs, nói với Cointelegraph: "Tôi sẽ cẩn thận đọc nhiều về kỷ lục của Bitcoin sau các kỳ giữa kỳ vừa qua. Chưa có đủ chu kỳ để gọi đó là mô hình và thị trường hiện được xây dựng khác: dòng ETF, danh mục đầu tư tổ chức và thanh khoản toàn cầu khiến giá biến động nhiều hơn so với trước đây".

posts.content:
The world’s second-largest crypto asset by market cap has had a rough couple of weeks. But its exchange reserves have dropped to around 14.5 million ETH as of November 2, levels last seen in 2016.

That’s a sharp decline from the 2020 peak of roughly 35 million, meaning about 20.5 million Ethereum, or 58.6%, has left tracked exchanges, according to CryptoQuant.

Binance is seeing a similar trend, as its reserves fell to 3.08 million ETH, approaching levels last recorded in late 2020. Compared with its 2025 peak of 4.9 million, the exchange has lost around 1.82 million, a 37.1% drop. Binance now holds approximately 21.2% of total exchange reserves, while the remaining 11.42 million ETH sits across other tracked platforms.

The decline means there is considerably less ETH readily available for spot selling. Lower exchange reserves don’t guarantee a price increase, but they could ease selling pressure and create more favorable conditions for price appreciation if buying demand picks up. With fewer coins sitting on exchanges, renewed buying could also have a stronger impact on ETH’s price.

Crypto Patel said that Ethereum, currently around $2,245, is approaching an important decision zone. The analyst believes current levels offer a good entry opportunity, but the preferred accumulation range is between $1,800 and $1,900, where a Bullish Order Block and Fair Value Gap overlap. The analyst wants to see a liquidity sweep and bullish confirmation before entering. If the setup plays out as expected, their long-term price targets are $2,700, $3,200, $4,400, $6,000, and $10,000.

But the institutional side of things continues to be gloomy. US spot Ethereum ETFs recorded their worst month since launch, with investors pulling out $1.61 billion in October, according to SoSoValue data. This surpassed the previous record of $1.42 billion in outflows set last November. October was particularly rough, as the funds saw just three days of net inflows. These were October 13, 21, and 23, bringing in only $24.84 million, $14.96 million, and $4.35 million, respectively.

The selling pressure also carried into November, with another $139.8 million withdrawn on the 2nd.

Tài sản tiền điện tử lớn thứ hai thế giới tính theo vốn hóa thị trường đã trải qua một vài tuần đầy khó khăn. Nhưng dự trữ trao đổi của nó đã giảm xuống còn khoảng 14,5 triệu ETH kể từ ngày 2 tháng 11, mức được nhìn thấy lần cuối vào năm 2016.

Đó là mức giảm mạnh so với mức đỉnh năm 2020 là khoảng 35 triệu, nghĩa là khoảng 20,5 triệu Ethereum, tương đương 58,6%, đã rời khỏi các sàn giao dịch được theo dõi, theo CryptoQuant.

Binance cũng đang chứng kiến ​​xu hướng tương tự khi lượng dự trữ của sàn này giảm xuống còn 3,08 triệu ETH, tiến gần đến mức được ghi nhận lần cuối vào cuối năm 2020. So với mức đỉnh 4,9 triệu vào năm 2025, sàn giao dịch đã mất khoảng 1,82 triệu, giảm 37,1%. Binance hiện nắm giữ khoảng 21,2% tổng dự trữ sàn giao dịch, trong khi 11,42 triệu ETH còn lại nằm trên các nền tảng được theo dõi khác.

Sự suy giảm có nghĩa là có ít ETH hơn đáng kể để bán giao ngay. Dự trữ ngoại hối thấp hơn không đảm bảo giá sẽ tăng, nhưng chúng có thể giảm bớt áp lực bán và tạo điều kiện thuận lợi hơn để tăng giá nếu nhu cầu mua tăng. Với ít tiền hơn trên các sàn giao dịch, việc mua mới cũng có thể có tác động mạnh hơn đến giá ETH.

Crypto Patel cho biết Ethereum, hiện ở mức khoảng 2.245 USD, đang tiến đến vùng quyết định quan trọng. Nhà phân tích tin rằng các mức hiện tại mang lại cơ hội gia nhập tốt, nhưng phạm vi tích lũy ưa thích là từ 1.800 USD đến 1.900 USD, trong đó Khối đặt hàng tăng giá và Khoảng cách giá trị hợp lý trùng nhau. Nhà phân tích muốn thấy sự quét thanh khoản và xác nhận xu hướng tăng giá trước khi tham gia. Nếu thiết lập diễn ra như mong đợi, mục tiêu giá dài hạn của họ là 2.700 USD, 3.200 USD, 4.400 USD, 6.000 USD và 10.000 USD.

Nhưng khía cạnh thể chế của mọi thứ vẫn tiếp tục ảm đạm. Theo dữ liệu của SoSoValue, các quỹ ETF Ethereum giao ngay tại Hoa Kỳ đã ghi nhận tháng tồi tệ nhất kể từ khi ra mắt, khi các nhà đầu tư rút 1,61 tỷ USD vào tháng 10. Con số này đã vượt qua kỷ lục trước đó là 1,42 tỷ USD dòng vốn được thiết lập vào tháng 11 năm ngoái. Tháng 10 đặc biệt khó khăn khi các quỹ chỉ chứng kiến ​​dòng vốn vào ròng trong ba ngày. Đó là các ngày 13, 21 và 23 tháng 10, chỉ mang về lần lượt 24,84 triệu USD, 14,96 triệu USD và 4,35 triệu USD.

Áp lực bán cũng kéo dài sang tháng 11, với 139,8 triệu USD khác bị rút vào ngày thứ 2.

posts.titleVi: Những người đi vay Aave phải đối mặt với APR lên tới 36% trong khi việc đóng băng tài sản thế chấp mới bị chặn
